statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-3505 (GHSA-cj8j-37rh-8475): the Bouncy Castle OpenPGP library (bcpg) did not bound the chunk size of AEAD encrypted data packets, so a crafted message could cause excessive resource use before authentication. bcpg-jdk18on before 1.84 is affected and 1.84 carries the fix (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cj8j-37rh-8475, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%903505, fix commit https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/commit/dc7530939ffb6cdb57636f3609d98e23b94e71c1, which the r1rv84 release tag contains and r1rv83 does not). The DHI gradle-8 package ships Bouncy Castle as jars in /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins. We read every published gradle-8 package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as listed in its index on 2026-11-26 (16 versions, 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.8-r0), after checking each package against its index checksum; the aarch64 package of each version has the same index checksum as the x86_64 one, and 8.14.5-r4 is published for x86_64 only. We opened every jar in each package, nested jars included. Bouncy Castle classes appear only in the bcprov-jdk18on, bcpg-jdk18on and bcutil-jdk18on jars, with no relocated copy in any other jar, and only the bcpg jar contains AEADEncDataPacket. Each bcpg jar is byte for byte the Maven Central release named in its file name and manifest: 1.78.1 in 8.14.4-r0 to 8.14.4-r3, 1.84 in 8.14.5-r3 to 8.14.5-r8 and 1.85 in 8.14.5-r9 to 8.14.8-r0. The 1.84 and 1.85 jars carry the fix (AEADEncDataPacket rejects a chunk size above 16 with 'chunkSize out of range', and the new PGPAEADUtil class is present); the 1.78.1 jar has neither. The range ends at 8.14.5-r3, the first build with bcpg-jdk18on 1.84.

CVE-2026-3505 (GHSA-cj8j-37rh-8475): Bouncy Castle bcpg does not bound the PGP AEAD chunk size, so a crafted message can exhaust resources before authentication. bcpg-jdk18on before 1.84 is affected; 1.84 fixes it (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cj8j-37rh-8475, https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/wiki/CVE%E2%80%902026%E2%80%903505, fix https://github.com/bcgit/bc-java/commit/dc7530939ffb6cdb57636f3609d98e23b94e71c1). We read every gradle-9 package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository as of 2026-11-27: 22 versions, 9.4.0-r0 to 9.9.2-r0. Each aarch64 package has the same index checksum as the x86_64 package of that version (9.6.1-r3 and 9.6.1-r4 are published for x86_64 only), so we read the x86_64 packages, checked each against its index checksum, and read every jar in them, including nested jars. The bcpg version comes from the Bundle-Version in the manifest of the bcpg-jdk18on jar under /usr/share/java/gradle/lib/plugins: bcpg 1.81 in 9.4.0-r0 to 9.4.1-r2, 1.84 in 9.5.0-r2 to 9.7.0-r1, 1.85 in 9.7.1-r0 to 9.8.2-r1 and 1.86 in 9.9.0-r0 to 9.9.2-r0. No other jar or nested jar in any of these builds carries org.bouncycastle.bcpg or org.bouncycastle.openpgp classes. The range ends at 9.5.0-r2, the first build with bcpg 1.84.
